stance_rationale: The draft materially overstates the implemented alpha: LightGBM did not run, RF-A1/RF-A2/RF-A3/RF-A6 are unresolved, top-20 turnover breaches the hard 600% annual cap, and PIT C13/C14/C15 are waived by assertion rather than evidence. The package should not be finalized until the model identity, PIT lineage, multi-testing diagnostics, and PG2 complementarity are revalidated.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet is Date x Ticker x score with 182 sig_dates, but 10 year-months are missing and gaps reach 91 days; score_lgbm is 100% NA, contradicting the claimed XGB+LGBM ensemble.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: factor_engine_proposal.R directly uses raw daily factor columns from .cache/factor_db_daily; Z_Score_Aligned is explicitly not used.
daily factor schema has no Usable_Date column, so Usable_Date <= sig_date cannot be audited.
open_dataset(.cache/factor_db_daily) and read_parquet(.cache/kr_factor_returns_v2.parquet) are used; load_month_factors() is not used.
BM 252d volatility uses shift(vol_252, 1L) before regime_pct construction.
fundamental-lag compliance is asserted via factor_db_daily_registry, but no annual-May or quarterly-45d proof is carried into the score artifact.

critical_concerns.description: The selected method is labeled XGBoost 5-seed + LightGBM 3-seed ensemble, but alpha_pipeline.log shows lightgbm missing and alpha_scores.parquet has score_lgbm NA for 100% of rows. RF-A2 is therefore unresolved because the composite adds no demonstrated factor/model value over XGB-only.

subperiod_stability is 0.3993, below the role prompt RF-A1 threshold of 0.50. The package downgrades the threshold to 0.20 and omits RF-A1 from challenge_flags, which is not an acceptable graduation interpretation.
recent_3y_icir is 1.5908 versus full ICIR 0.6551, exceeding the RF-A3 threshold of full ICIR x 1.5. This is a direct recent-overfit flag, not a minor disclosure item.
Top-20 turnover proxy is 7.2298 annualized, or 722.98%, above the hard 600% annual turnover cap before optimizer costs. A 15 bps one-way KR implementation cannot treat this as alpha-only trivia.

Harvey_t is computed as a plain mean/sd t-stat despite a Newey-West comment, DSR is a proxy z-minus-expected-max value, and n_trials=5 ignores MI top40 selection across hundreds of factors plus model/hyperparameter choices. RF-A6 multi-testing inflation remains open.

PIT C13/C14/C15 are marked N/A using an L-164 carve-out, but the base prompt still mandates Z_Score_Aligned, Usable_Date <= sig_date, and load_month_factors() for Factor DB access. The artifact lacks auditable PIT lineage for raw daily fundamental-derived fields.

The time-series alpha artifact is not single-snapshot, but monthly consistency is imperfect: 10 year-months are missing from 2008-01 through 2023-12, with gaps up to 91 days. RF-A7 is not triggered, but schedule integrity needs explanation before downstream walk-forward use.

PG2 complementarity is asserted from M05 NAV correlation and an expectation that M06 correlation will be lower; no M06 vs STR_1701 NAV correlation, TDC, crisis_alpha, weights.csv, or covariance artifact exists for this WT.
Core references are paper names without page-level support, and the KR applicability argument is mostly imported from generic ML asset-pricing literature rather than a KR-specific causal validation.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet has 353635 rows, 182 sig_dates, 2983 tickers, and a valid Date/Ticker/score_ens shape, so the Iter 4 single-snapshot failure is not the primary defect.
Liquidity filter evidence is strong at the artifact level: min AvgTV20 is 291058587 KRW and no rows are below 2e8 KRW.
C9 regime lag is implemented with shift(vol_252, 1L), and lockbox leakage is not apparent because the score range ends at 2023-12-28.
unresolved_disputes: Whether L-164 v1.1 truly overrides PIT C13/C14/C15 for daily ML raw factor reads is not proven inside the required base context or artifacts.
weights.csv is absent at qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260426_006/weights.csv, so the requested schedule validation cannot be performed.
qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260426_006 is absent; the only alpha artifact found is stage_artifacts/WT_D20260426_006/alpha_scores.parquet.
covariance.parquet is absent for this WT, so PSD and post-shrink condition <= 100 cannot be audited.
risk_package, optimization_package, and other 3-agent context packages are absent from the WT directory.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that this is a validated XGB+LGBM PG2 diversifier whose recent IC strength will improve the 20% PG2 sleeve, despite LightGBM not running, ICIR underperforming M05, turnover breaching the hard cap, and PG2 correlation/backtest artifacts being absent.
rebuttal_required: Rerun with LightGBM installed or relabel the method as XGB-only; provide non-NA score_lgbm coverage and XGB-only vs ensemble ICIR deltas.
Apply RF-A1 at the 0.50 threshold and RF-A2 against the best available single factor/model, not only a 5% absolute-delta rule.
Replace the Harvey/DSR proxy with Newey-West HAC t-stat, true deflated Sharpe logic, and 5-spec CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6 reporting.
Provide PIT proof for daily factor reads, including Usable_Date or an approved loader/registry trail that enforces C4/C13/C14/C15.
Provide a weights schedule, turnover after optimization, M06 vs STR_1701 NAV correlation, TDC, crisis_alpha, and PG2 blended SR before finalization.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The artifacts support a multi-date XGB-only score matrix, not the claimed XGB+LGBM ensemble or a completed PG2 validation. At least two-source PASS is not available.

alpha_specific_questions: If LightGBM did not run, what exactly is the incremental alpha source versus M05 XGB and why is RF-A2 not active?
Can the daily factor DB raw-read carve-out be reconciled with PIT C13/C14/C15 using auditable Usable_Date or loader evidence?
Can the strategy remain below 600% annual turnover after optimizer constraints while preserving ICIR and PG2 blended SR?
